title: Family Crest
start: Talk to Dimintheis in south-east Varrock, next to the Fancy Clothes Store.

ironman.t: These are not required if you obtain the items required as a drop instead.
45 Cooking (to cook fish, swordfish requires the highest level)
50 Fishing (to catch raw fish, raw swordfish requires the highest level)

items.t: Antipoison or super antipoison, any number of doses
Runes, magic weapon and standard spellbook to cast Air, Water, Earth, and Fire Blast which require 59 Magic Boostable
A deathtouched dart can be used instead of Magic to kill Chronozon

recommended.t: Activated Al Kharid, Ardougne, Edgeville, Falador and Varrock lodestones
Activated Fort Forinthry lodestone, Fort Forinthry Teleport scrolls, earth altar teleport, or an archaeology journal to teleport to the Infernal Source Dig Site for easy access to Johnathon

rewards.t: Family gauntlets, which can then be enchanted into chaos, cooking, or smelting gauntlets.

To change the enchantment on the gauntlets, use the right-click switch option for 25,000 coins each time. To own all three versions simultaneously, first speak with Dimintheis about buying new steel gauntlets, then visit the other two respective brothers and pay them 1,000,000 coins each.

If players drop or destroy the family gauntlets immediately upon receiving them to reclaim them from Dimintheis, Dimintheis gives back both the cooking and smelting gauntlets. This may be a way to only have to pay 1,000,000 coins for the chaos gauntlets if desired.

steps.t: Talk to Dimintheis in the house next to the Fancy Clothes Store in south-eastern Varrock. [Chat: 3 Hi, I am a bold adventurer. › 2 So where is this crest? › Accept]

Go to Gertrude's house west of Varrock and talk to Caleb, who is inside the house (although he can sometimes wander outside). [Chat: 1 Are you Caleb Fitzharmon? › 2 So can I have your bit? › 1 Ok, I will get those.]
p: Caleb, found near Gertrude's house in Varrock

steps.t: Talk to him again with swordfish, bass, tuna, salmon, and shrimp in the backpack to get a crest part.
Then ask Caleb where the rest of the crest is. [Chat: 1 Uh... what happened to the rest of it?].
Talk to Avan just south of the Al Kharid mine. [Chat: 2 I'm looking for a man named Avan Fitzharmon.]
Enter the Dwarven mines north-east of Falador.
Head south-west of the general store and talk to Boot. [Chat: 1 Hello. I'm in search of very high quality gold.]
Travel to Witchaven, south-east of the Ardougne lodestone. Climb down the ruins just to the west of the town. Run past the hobgoblins towards the elongated room with the Ogres.
Solve the puzzle:

sub.t: Logging out will reset this puzzle.
Head to the northern lever located outside the room and pull it up.
Head to the southern lever, located inside the room, and pull it up.
Return to the northern room and pull the lever outside the room down.
Enter the northern room and push the lever in there up.
Leave the room and pull the one outside the northern room up.
Go back to the southern room and pull the inside lever down.
Now enter the room with the hellhounds.

steps.t: Mine two 'Perfect' gold ore in the hellhound room. You will continue to mine gold while being attacked by hellhounds if you turn auto-retaliate off.

Smelt the ores into bars and then craft a 'Perfect' ring and a 'Perfect' necklace with two rubies at any furnace. There is a furnace just northwest of the Al Kharid lodestone. [Chat: 1 Yes smelt 'perfect' golden ring. › 2 Yes smelt 'perfect' golden necklace.]
Go back to south of the Al Kharid mine and give them to Avan.
Talk to Johnathon on the floor 2 of the Jolly Boar Inn south-west of the Fort Forinthry lodestone.
p: The safespot from the demon on the north-west side of the cave (camera facing north)

steps.t: Use an antipoison on him. [Chat: 2 Where can I find Chronozon?]
Teleport to Edgeville and prepare for the final fight which will use multiple casts of the four blast spells. The other elemental spells do not work.
Enter Edgeville Dungeon and run north and then west.
Kill Chronozon when it appears.

sub.t: Chronozon must be hit with all four elemental blast spells or deathtouched dart in order to be killed, or otherwise it will return to full health when it is nearly dead. Once it has been hit with all four elemental blast spells, other types of damage can be used to kill it.
Only the following elemental spells will work: Air Blast, Water Blast, Earth Blast, Fire Blast.
If you use a high tier magic weapon (tier 70+), it will be very hard as you will kill him before being able to deal all 4 types of damage, therefore use a low-tier weapon (tier 30 or 40).

steps.t: Kill him and take the crest piece.
Talk to Dimintheis.
Quest complete!
Talk to Dimintheis again for cooking and smelting gauntlets. [Chat: 1 Ask about gauntlets. › 1 Reclaim lost gauntlets › 1 Yes please.]

p: Avan wearing his yellow cape at the mines

get_inside.text: Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.
